A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] '''executive''' once hired the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword]] to protect him. While under the organization's care, the Sullustan came under fire from an industrial [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] squad. In the ensuing [[Unidentified Aurodium Sword skirmish|skirmish]], the Sullustan was protected by team members including a [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] known as [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Snoova]], and [[Unidentified Wookiee mercenary|another Wookiee]]. An [[Unidentified Imperial intelligence agent|Imperial intelligence agent]] attained an image of the conflict and included it in a report on the mercenary organization intended for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] included the report and image in his dossier on various underworld figures compiled in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Although pictured, the Sullustan went nameless in the document.<ref name="UAGoSaV">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref>
